docstring: Spectraformer: Random Feature Linear Attention with Flexible Kernel Approximation. Replaces softmax attention with random orthogonal feature projections, enabling true linear O(N·r·d) time and memory complexity.  Production-Hardened with: - Multi-architecture copy_weights (GPT-2, RoBERTa/BERT nested, Qwen/LLaMA, DistilBERT) - Frobenius norm validat
